title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Treasury Schedule — Floor Base Amount by Payout Volume
content:
**Clause.** The base amount on which the replenishment floor of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is built depends on the service's payouts: for a service that sent payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, it is the greater of the tier's default low-balance alert level and that month's payout total divided by 4; for a service that sent no payout in that month but has earlier payouts, it is the greater of the default and its largest single payout; for any other service it is the default.

| Payout history of the service | Base amount |
|---|---|
| payouts in the month ending today | the greater of the default alert level and that month's payout total divided by 4 |
| no payout in that month, earlier payouts | the greater of the default alert level and the largest single payout |
| no payout ever | the default alert level |

| Tier | Default low-balance alert level (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 100 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 250 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 500 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 1000 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 5000 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 10000 |

The month's payout total is the sum of every payout on the service's ledger dated in that month; the largest single payout is the largest payout the service has ever booked.

## Worked figures (a hypothetical tier default of 300.00)

- Payouts this month totalling 1380.00: 1380.00 divided by 4 is 345.00, greater than 300.00, so the base amount is 345.00.
- Payouts this month totalling 760.00: 190.00, so the base amount is 300.00.
- No payout this month; largest earlier payout 420.00: 420.00.
- No payout ever: 300.00.

When today is the 20th of a month, a payout dated the 21st of the previous month falls in the month ending today, and one dated the 20th of the previous month does not.
